summary: Formats a lap-count display string into destination buffer a1. Computes the current lap as the value at dword_7C54E0 + 16444 (decimal, +0x403C) plus 1, clamps it to the total lap count dword_8ACF8C, and calls StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck either with the unlimited-lap format string (aDD_1, " %d/--") when dword_8ACF8C equals 0x7FFFFFFF or with the normal format (aD_2, " %d/%d") plus the total otherwise. Always returns 0. The second argument a2 is not referenced in the body.
